name: Snt Dynamics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Snt Dynamics Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells precision machinery. It offers defense products, including powertrains, guns and artillery systems, and protection weapons; auto parts, such as axles and transmission products; and machine tools, such as gear cutting machines, CNC vertical lathes, grinding machines, and universal lathes. The company was formerly known as S&T Dynamics Co. Ltd. and changed its name to SNT DYNAMICS CO.,Ltd. in February 2021. SNT DYNAMICS CO.,Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is based in Changwon-Si, South Korea.
